propositions: Cancelled ACLI link delete commands (exit code from EOF on stdin) are counted toward links_applied despite the operation not executing, causing batch_outcome to report error=None with fabricated success metrics.

The except CalledProcessError arm in _update_one_dispatch_links increments _links_applied for all subprocess failures, treating them as idempotent 404/409 races without distinguishing deterministic failures (confirmation prompt EOF) from transient races.

ACLI link create and link delete subcommands accept --yes flag to suppress confirmation prompts (verified against acli 1.3.19-stable help), paralleling the existing precedent in workitem delete, but neither call site passes it.
The silent-divergence canary REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP cannot detect this defect because it tests computed>0 and applied==0, but the miscounting arm inflates applied to equal computed.
Idempotent race markers (404, 409, does-not-exist, not-found) must be detected on both stderr and stdout to avoid false-positives, matching the precedent at delete_issue in acli.py:739-742.
